name: Making Memories
source:
As Alvaro , you go through a life altering event alongside a young woman who herself is having a hard time coping with such sudden changes in her life.

With nowhere else to go he would reach out to the only person he knows would help him legally as well as emotionally - with some unresolved feelings between them too.

On this journey love will reach out to you from unexpected places and the nature of your relationships will go through major re-evaluations.

[From [url=https://kvitravntales.itch.io/making-memories]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你将扮演阿尔瓦罗，与一名年轻女子共同经历一场改变人生的变故，而她自己也难以适应生活中突如其来的变化。

无处可去的他，只能向那个确信会在法律和情感上帮助自己的人求助，而两人之间，也还有尚未厘清的感情。

在这段旅程中，爱会从意想不到的地方向你伸出手，你与他人的关系也将迎来重大的重新审视。

[摘自[url=https://kvitravntales.itch.io/making-memories]Itch.io[/url]]
